added: packages/promotion (@sos-2/promotion): the evidence-gated promotion/rollback gate evaluatePromotion(candidate, { authority, assurance, evidence }) — deterministic and total, producing exactly ONE decision from the frozen six (ACT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE, ASK, REJECT, ROLLBACK — consumed from @sos-2/authority's DECISION_ACTIONS, never redefined), a full reason audit trail and a Decision-kind spine artifact record; gate order: candidate shape -> live guardrails (triggered ROLLBACK trigger records -> decision ROLLBACK, safety first) -> CURRENT authority -> compatible current System State -> CURRENT assurance -> CURRENT evidence -> bounded recovery

packages/promotion authority gate: CURRENT authority through @sos-2/authority's exported evaluation (assertValidGrant + evaluateGrant + scopeCovers + the frozen permission vocabulary, requiring the PROMOTE permission) — expired, revoked, scope-violating and permission-less grants REJECT; CONFIDENCE IS NOT AUTHORIZATION (locked invariant — the candidate's confidence mark is never consulted; a high-confidence candidate without a valid grant is REJECTED, pinned by tests); an INDETERMINATE evaluation (a revision-bound grant bound to a foreign artifact, or an evaluation input the grant cannot be evaluated against) yields ASK — the first-class, successful ask-the-authority decision (R16), never an error; revision-bound grants ON the candidate evaluate deterministically against the candidate's envelope version

packages/promotion assurance gate: the AssuranceCase-shaped fixture input (claims + verdict + validity — the W8 parallelization fixture) is validated and truthfully evaluated, NEVER assumed valid: structurally invalid cases and REFUTED verdicts REJECT promotion; INCOMPLETE verdicts and non-CURRENT validity (EXPIRED, SUPERSEDED, VIOLATED) block it with GATHER_EVIDENCE; a case declaring CURRENT whose expires_at closed before the evaluation instant is truthfully evaluated EXPIRED (deterministic instant comparison, mirroring @sos-2/authority's grant expiry rule)

packages/promotion evidence gate: CURRENT evidence — intervention-grade for causal claims (INTERVENTIONAL class + SUCCESS availability + subject-bound to the candidate + FRESH), freshness consumed from @sos-2/evidence's evaluateFreshness (the merged W3 authority — never re-implemented); LLM-produced evidence (llm_output) is never authoritative (§18); SIMULATED RECORDS NEVER SATISFY INTERVENTION REQUIREMENTS — every record carrying the simulation mark (isSimulatedRecord from @sos-2/experiments) is rejected loudly with an explicit reason; decision mapping: no real intervention evidence at all -> EXPERIMENT, existing-but-not-current -> GATHER_EVIDENCE, simulated-records-presented-as-intervention-evidence -> REJECT

packages/promotion recovery: the BoundedRecoveryDeclaration — a STRUCTURAL MIRROR of the unmerged W8 @sos-2/recovery-control contract (no W8 source imported): mechanism description + bounded max_recovery_seconds OR a governed containment exception (authority_ref + note; exactly one of the two paths — §13 'Live changes require bounded recovery unless a governed exception defines another containment mechanism'), with rollback triggers WIRED to @sos-2/experiments guardrail TriggerRecords (kind ROLLBACK, experiment id + exact conditions); an ACT decision without a valid declaration REJECTS

packages/promotion record: PromotionDecisionArtifact — Decision-kind spine artifacts (deterministic content-addressed ids) recording the action, the candidate, the consulted authority grant / assurance case / satisfying evidence records (exact spine ids — R30 reproducibility), the full reasons, the recovery declaration (REQUIRED when and only when the action is ACT), the system-state revision snapshot and the wired live trigger rule ids; an ACT record without recovery and a non-ACT record with recovery are both rejected

packages/promotion golden fixture: promotion-decision.json — the golden ACT decision reproduced bit-exactly by evaluatePromotion on the documented golden path (pinned by test/fixtures.test.ts), carrying a bounded recovery declaration wired to a real guardrail trigger record
preserved_invariants: the Decision/ASK vocabulary is consumed from @sos-2/authority's frozen DECISION_ACTIONS — exactly the six outcomes ACT, EXPERIMENT, GATHER_EVIDENCE, ASK, REJECT, ROLLBACK; no new outcome is invented, no outcome is redefined (spec/architecture-lock.md 'Decision/ASK semantics'); ASK remains a SUCCESS state (a valid outcome), never an error class

'confidence alone authorizing risky changes' remains forbidden (spec/architecture-lock.md): the promotion gate evaluates authority FIRST and never reads the candidate's confidence mark for authorization — pinned by negative tests (high-confidence candidates without valid/expiring grants are REJECTED)

promotion remains evidence gated (spec/architecture.md §14 'Promotion is evidence gated. A passing test suite is not equivalent to a successful mission outcome'): ACT requires current authority + current assurance + current (intervention-grade for causal claims) evidence + compatible current System State + a valid bounded recovery declaration — every other configuration lands on a non-promoting decision

intervention evidence outranks observational correlation for strong causal claims (§18): causal candidates require INTERVENTIONAL-class SUCCESS evidence; observational records — however many — never suffice; freshness is delegated to @sos-2/evidence's evaluateFreshness (the merged W3 authority, never re-implemented)

simulation is evaluation infrastructure, never evidence: simulated records (the mark @sos-2/experiments' simulator stamps on every outcome) are rejected loudly by the evidence gate and never satisfy intervention requirements (docs/implementation/TESTING-AND-EVIDENCE.md layer-6 semantics — pinned by tests in both packages)
LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization (§18): llm_output-marked evidence records do not satisfy the promotion evidence requirements

unknown guardrails are never treated as success: live experiments with NOT_ESTABLISHED guardrails produce triggered, fail-closed rollback triggers in @sos-2/experiments, which the promotion gate honors as decision ROLLBACK — never ACT (pinned by negative tests)

every live change declares rollback mechanism, trigger, authority and evidence (docs/assurance-model.md): ACT records carry a bounded recovery declaration wired to experiment guardrail trigger records; bounded recovery or a governed containment exception — never neither, never both

the Semantic Spine remains the only identity/envelope authority: decision records are spine envelopes with deterministic content-addressed ids; the consulted artifacts are cited by exact spine ids; no frozen contract in spec/contracts/ was modified; spec/, docs/, root files and sibling-owned paths are untouched — all changes are additive under the two owned packages
boundary_changes: one new workspace package @sos-2/promotion, depending at runtime on @sos-2/semantic-spine, @sos-2/authority (frozen Decision vocabulary, AuthorityGrant evaluation, PROMOTE permission), @sos-2/evidence (EvidenceRecordW3, evaluateFreshness) and @sos-2/experiments (CandidateState fixture, TriggerRecord wiring, the simulation mark); devDependency @sos-2/architecture for the W2-bridge compatibility test only

the AssuranceCase fixture contract (claims + verdict + validity, frozen-kind spine id) is pinned here as the W9 input contract for unmerged W8 assurance cases, and the BoundedRecoveryDeclaration structurally mirrors the unmerged W8 @sos-2/recovery-control contract — W8 integrates without contract changes (asserted by compatibility tests); no W7/W8 source is imported
